name: Lice Plague Of
overview: The Lice Plague, as recorded in Exodus 8:16-19, demonstrates God's sovereign power over creation and His authority in judgment. By commanding Aaron to strike the dust, God caused it to become lice throughout Egypt, affecting both man and beast, a plague the Egyptian magicians could not replicate despite their enchantments. This miraculous sign revealed God's direct intervention, described by the magicians as the 'finger of God,' yet Pharaoh's heart remained hardened, fulfilling God's sovereign will.
